description: This file defines the ConcatBinary class, which represents a binary expression node for string concatenation within the Twig templating engine. It extends AbstractBinary and implements the operator method to output the concatenation operator ('.').

classes.name: ConcatBinary
classes.description: A class representing the concatenation binary operation in Twig's expression syntax.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw '.' operator for string concatenation in the compiled template code.
